title: Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail, 22-Inch, Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear bathroom counter clutter and keep toiletries within easy reach with a double glass shelf designed for organized, secure storage.

  • Use vertical space efficiently with a double-shelf design that creates two levels of storage on the wall.
  • Keep items in place thanks to the integrated gallery rail along the front edge.
  • Choose strength and safety with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass shelves.
  • Maintain a clean finished look with concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection for a cohesive set of transitional bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Configuration: Double glass shelf with gallery rail
  • Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
  • Overall dimensions: 22-Inch L x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch H
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-inch)
  • Material: Solid brass hardware with tempered glass
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
